prompt: How many times in the history of the Summer Olympic Games has the United States not topped the medal table?
answer:
Using the **overall medal count** (gold + silver + bronze), the United States has **not topped the Summer Olympic medal table 14 times**. It has led the total-medal table 16 times out of the 30 Summer Games held through Paris 2024.

This includes 1980, when the U.S. boycotted the Moscow Games. Counting only Olympics in which the U.S. competed, it failed to lead the total-medal table **13 times**.

If “medal table” means the conventional **gold-medal ranking**, the answer is **11 times**.
